title: Lemon Aioli with Boiled Potatoes and Vegetables
summary: Whole pasteurised egg blended with lemon juice, zest and garlic into a thick aioli, served with boiled vegetables and lemon.

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, crushed to a paste
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Simmer the potatoes in a pan of unsalted water until tender, 15-20 min, dropping in the beans and carrot sticks for the final 4-5 min. Drain well.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Blitz the egg, lemon juice and zest, mustard powder, garlic, salt, sugar and cayenne for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Add the oil
steps.text: With the motor running, trickle in the sunflower oil over about 2 min until thick. Scrape down and stir in the olive oil by hand.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve a bowl of aioli with the warm vegetables and lemon wedges; keep the rest in a jar in the fridge.

tips: Use pasteurised eggs; pregnant women, young children, older people and anyone unwell should skip raw-egg sauces.
Grate the zest before squeezing the lemon.
Adding the olive oil by hand keeps it from turning bitter.
For a cooked-egg version, heat the egg with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water over simmering water to 71 °C first.
storage: Keep the aioli covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
